prompts.blade:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: modular 2D RPG hero SWORD ATTACK sprite sheet, actual alpha transparency.
Input image: reference is the existing approved hero walk sheet, use EXACT same female hero identity, orange-brown bun, blue scarf and blue tunic, cream sleeves and apron, belt pouch, brown boots, same painterly crisp outlined low-resolution game sprite style and body proportions.
Primary request: Draw entirely NEW whole-body sword attack poses for this SAME hero. Precisely 16 separated full-body figures arranged as 4 equal rows and 4 equal columns on a square transparent canvas. Row 1 faces front/down; row 2 faces left; row 3 faces right; row 4 faces away/up. Each row has four genuinely different poses in order: ready anticipation with bent knees, raised sword windup with shoulders turned, striking slash with body following through and other arm balancing, recovery to standing. Weapon: simple iron short sword in right hand. No visual trails or particles, no shadows below feet, no scenery, no grid lines, no text or labels. All figures entirely within their cells with generous transparent gutters and no overlapping neighbors. Uniform camera, lighting and scale. Feet at the same baseline within each row, center of feet at the horizontal center of each cell. Each body is roughly 65 percent of cell height so upward sword leaves generous padding. Preserve reference identity and same 4 viewpoints, draw all limbs and silhouette with actual joint changes. This is NOT a character redesign. Output real RGBA transparency.

prompts.bow_correction:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset: existing 4 by 4 transparent RPG bow-attack sprite atlas.
Correct ONLY shooting directions and arm/torso orientation. Preserve exactly the same character, clothing, bun, blue scarf, painterly outlined style, cell positions, scale, 16 figures, alpha transparency and baseline. In row 2 the hero faces LEFT and must aim and shoot LEFT in columns 2,3,4: bow is held in the forward left hand to the LEFT of the body, string hand draws back towards the face on the RIGHT. The fully drawn third pose must match the second pose's leftwards aim; fourth pose shows release leftwards with empty string. Row 3 faces RIGHT and must aim and shoot RIGHT in columns 2,3,4: bow on RIGHT of body, string hand drawn to cheek on LEFT; third and fourth poses match direction of second. Row 1 aims forward/down towards viewer in a foreshortened frontal pose, not towards the right. Row 4 aims away/up from viewer; bow raised ahead of face, not sideways. No new ornaments, arrows floating away or trails, no labels, no background. Every cell remains a genuinely different whole-body phase: relaxed, raising/drawing, fully drawn, released. Keep generous gutters. Genuine RGBA transparent output.
